## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about Sherlocks AI pricing.

### What counts as an investigation?

An investigation is triggered when Sherlocks receives an alert from your monitoring tools and dispatches AI agents to analyze it. Correlated alerts within the same incident window count as a single investigation.

### Is the Free plan really free?

Yes. 30 investigations per month at no cost, no credit card required. It is designed so small teams and individual SREs can get real value before ever talking to sales.

### What happens if I exceed 30 investigations on the Free plan?

Further investigations pause until the next monthly reset, or you can upgrade to Enterprise for unlimited investigations and SLAs.

### What is included in Enterprise?

Unlimited investigations, a dedicated Field Engineer for setup, a named support engineer with SLA, SSO / SAML, audit logs, RBAC, custom dashboards, and optional air-gapped or in-VPC LLM deployments for regulated environments.

### Is my data secure?

Yes. Watson, our data agent, runs inside your VPC with read-only access. We are SOC 2 Type 2 certified, and for regulated industries we offer fully air-gapped deployments.
